label: Late copy phase (last ~3 outputs), favoring inputs l/q/p/n/3/z/f/j/u/1
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), and only from recall_idx >= 2 onward. It never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or on the first two outputs. Activity is concentrated near the end of the copy: to_go 0 and 1 hold about 74% of the mass, and to_go <= 2 holds 86%. Within that window it fires on only about 19% of steps. Which steps fire depends on the token: the fed-back input in_tok (the previous output) being one of l, q, p, n, 3, z, f, j, u or 1 roughly doubles the rate, and h and o are weak. The strongest activations come from short L=3 sequences at the final step (recall_idx 2), especially when the input is q, f, p or l. The predicate gets dev F1 0.45, precision 0.38, mass recall 0.62. The remaining selectivity is spread across token combinations and is not captured cleanly.
